seo.title: Contact — Alder Health
seo.description: Reach the Alder Health example team by email or phone, or send a message about access needs and booking.

intro.title: Talk to the example team.
intro.lead: Questions about booking, access needs or getting to a clinic. We answer on weekdays, and there is no wrong way to ask.

form.heading: Send a message
form.note: This is a design demonstration. The form checks what you type and then tells you plainly that nothing was sent.
form.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what you need help with.
form.unavailableMessage: Nothing was sent. This demonstration has no message service behind it, so please use the email address or phone number listed here instead.

items.copy: For access needs or help with the booking process.

notice.title: Do not send medical details
notice.copy: This is a design demonstration. Do not send sensitive medical information to the example addresses above. For an emergency, contact your local emergency services.
